scope.fixture: synthetic valid 8x8 grayscale SOF0 baseline JPEG with COM segments inserted before SOS; no clipboard, window, helper, package, or physical input
assertions: The decoder accepts a valid image whose cumulative COM payload is exactly 1 MiB and returns the expected 8x8 opaque gray pixels.
The decoder rejects cumulative COM payload of 1 MiB plus one byte with image_worker_capacity_exceeded.

limitations: This synthetic fixture verifies the cumulative COM byte threshold only; it does not establish limits for every JPEG metadata marker or a broad JPEG corpus.
The result does not establish a hard memory bound, packaged behavior, product deadline, or complete T04 acceptance.
